S1 · System

Heat. Power. Code.

Thermal engineering
& energy systems modelling

I build and test engineering models that connect physical assumptions to practical questions in heat, power and energy systems. My work spans compressible CFD/CHT, dispatch optimisation and software workflows with explicit checks and documented limits. I have completed the M.Sc. in Sustainable Energy Engineering at KTH, including my 30 ECTS thesis; my degree certificate is in process.

Interested in research-engineer and PhD opportunities in thermal-fluid engineering, energy systems and nuclear-energy applications.

Complete project library →

Open methods, inspectable code, and explicit limits. The case studies distinguish numerical verification, coursework and exploratory modelling from real-system validation.

View case study →01

CFD & Testing · Apr 2025 - Nov 2025

Siemens Energy Thesis - High-Temperature Reducer CFD/CHT and Measurement-Chain Commissioning

Industrial thesis at Siemens Energy Finspång combining preliminary NI-DAQ/LabVIEW commissioning and supervised heater-failure troubleshooting with a 15-run numerical CFD/CHT comparison of Pulsatorn reducer geometries.

ANSYS Fluent · CFD/CHT · k-omega SST · NI-DAQ · LabVIEW · Siemens NX

Case study →
View case study →02

Thermal Systems · 2026

TES Discharge Screen · Dynamic thermal-storage screening

Techno-economic screening of industrial thermal energy storage with state-of-charge-dependent discharge constraints derived from dynamic models. Packed-bed, molten-salt and PCM cases are compared with explicit verification, sensitivity and validation boundaries.

Python · Pyomo · HiGHS · Modelica · FMI/FMPy · SALib

Case study →GitHub ↗
View case study →03

Energy Systems · 2026

OpenSteamOpt · Steam & power RTO

An open-source two-boiler steam-and-power twin with a carbon-aware Pyomo/HiGHS scheduler, OpenModelica FMI 2.0 simulation and a local Streamlit advisory GUI. Synthetic and uncalibrated; not an ABB product or live control system.

Python · Modelica · Pyomo · HiGHS · FMI/FMPy · Streamlit · pytest

Case study →GitHub ↗

Energy Systems · 2026

Kerala2040 · Power-system resilience research

Public-data research freeze (23 October 2026) on Kerala's electricity-system stress, with observed SLDC daily targets, ERA5 retrospective demand analysis, hydro timing and bounded transmission screening. Not a validated planning model.

Python · PyPSA · OSeMOSYS · ERA5 · HiGHS · GIS · pytest

Refine the mesh

Three levels, the way the thesis ran them

Pick a level and watch the cells and near-wall layers fill the reducer. The schematic is not the real geometry.

Mesh independence is not validation. It says the answer stopped changing with the grid, not that the grid matches the rig.

Open questions

Questions that connect the work.

Full research statement →
I

Thermal engineering

How do geometry, surface condition and thermal resistance affect high-temperature heat transfer? I’m interested in transient CHT and carefully bounded experimental–numerical comparison.

Thermal methods & evidence →
II

Energy systems modelling

How do demand, network limits and storage change system decisions? My work explores heat and power dispatch, grid flexibility, hydrogen and electricity investment.

Energy systems work →
III

Industrial decarbonisation

How can operational data support defensible energy decisions? My focus includes energy-performance indicators, load drivers, metering gaps and transparent emissions calculations.

Industrial methodology →
IV

Nuclear-energy applications

How can existing thermal-fluid, systems and computational engineering skills transfer into nuclear R&D? I’m exploring nuclear thermal-hydraulics and reactor systems while building the nuclear-specific foundation needed for credible work.

Research direction →

S5 · Evidence · October 2026

New research & open methods.

Reports & PDFs →

Independent work and an upstream contribution span model-output verification, climate-scenario evidence, research-workflow integrity and open energy-model documentation. Software checks, numerical screening and empirical validation are deliberately separated.

Open Energy Methods · alpha

EnerLint

Independent conservation-law checks with analytical fault injections. A compensating error that passes the checks is reported rather than hidden.
